changelog:
Initial release: Download and archive Perplexity.ai conversations as Markdown files.

- Supports single thread download, bulk download from list, and full history export.
- Generates clean, well-structured Markdown for each thread; each thread saved as a separate `.md` file.
- Outputs files to `~/perplexity-downloader/outputs/` with sanitized filenames; supports progress reporting and error handling.
- Includes index file for bulk and full history downloads.
- Handles edge cases such as access denied, missing sources, long threads, non-English content, and manual fallback for login-gated threads.
- Accessible via trigger phrases like "download perplexity thread" or "export perplexity history".
summary: Download and save Perplexity.ai conversations as individual Markdown files. One thread = one .md file. Processes threads sequentially. Supports single thread, URL lists, or full history export. Triggers on "download perplexity thread", "export perplexity history", "save all perplexity threads", or any request to capture Perplexity conversations.
